observations.explanation: The paper presents six diverse application examples and describes varied agent roles and conversation patterns (PDF pp. 2, 8–9).
The MiniWob++ comparison covers twelve clicking tasks, and reports success rates over ten instances for each task (PDF pp. 15–16).

The initial comparison is indeed qualitative and limited to two MATH problems tested three times each (PDF pp. 10–11). But the paper also reports a follow-up quantitative evaluation on 12 level-5 problems, with one trial per problem, so describing the math comparison overall as very small and qualitative omits relevant evidence (PDF p. 11).
The paper explicitly lists unresolved questions about which tasks benefit from multi-agent workflows and what workflow is optimal and cost-effective (PDF p. 23).
